rules_text:
Rules summary Turn Summary 1. Connect a link from your stock to a bracelets-in-assembly. 2. If there are no valid connections, you must start a new bracelet. 3. If a bracelet has length >= 5, it may be completed for points if key and lock match together. If you choose to do so, you must start a new bracelet. 4. Repeat 1-3. Point System Category Action Points Incomplete bracelets Place link and match 1 lock and key 1 Match 2nd lock and key in same turn 3 Completed bracelet elements Bronze links 1 Silver links 2 Gold links 3 Each link > 5 in a bracelet 2 An opponent’s gemstones captured when completing a bracelet 1 per gemstone captured Domination - All gemstones are yours 10 Links with emeralds, rubies or sapphires 5 per link Links with diamonds 10 per link Link completing bracelet Match 1 lock and key 4 Match both locks and keys 8 Using a link with a Master lock -4 Elements of a Link

---

Love Links is a 2-4 player game that lets players create and wear bracelets made of precious metals and jewels.

Players place 2 bracelet links during their turn, joining to links already placed by other players according to the properties of links already played.

If a bracelet is completed then the player receives points according to length of the bracelet, the metal in the bracelet, the jewels and its other features. And the player receives the bracelet to wear!

—description from the designer

The player with the most points after all bracelet links have been played wins.
